description: Experimental relationship patterns for a positive statement followed by coercive wording that undermines its promise. Describes observable rhetorical structure, never intent. Not simple co-occurrence.

patterns.title: Freedom of choice followed by pressure
patterns.summary: Language that offers free choice is immediately undercut by a demand, penalty or threat tied to that choice.
positiveCues: \b(?:no pressure|(?:it's|it is|the|this is) (?:your|entirely your) (?:choice|decision)|the (?:choice|decision) is yours|(?:you(?:'re| are) free|you're free) to (?:choose|decide)|(?:it's|it is) up to you|take (?:the|your) time (?:you need|to decide)|you (?:don't|do not) have to (?:decide|agree|answer|sign) (?:right )?now)\b
\b(?:make (?:the|your) choice (?:that is|that's|that feels) right for you|you can (?:decide|choose) for yourself)\b
negativeCues: \b(?:you (?:must|have to|need to|are required to) (?:agree|support|endorse|approve|accept|comply|back|vote for|sign (?:the|this|our) (?:pledge|petition|statement|agreement))\b|(?:you(?:'ll| will) (?:lose|be (?:fired|excluded|punished|banned|removed|shamed)|regret)\b)|(?:we(?:'ll| will) (?:fire|exclude|punish|ban|remove|shame|blacklist|expose|publish your name|tell everyone)\b)|(?:if you (?:don't|do not|won't|refuse to) (?:agree|support|approve|accept|comply|sign|vote)\b)|(?:unless you (?:agree|support|approve|accept|comply|sign|vote)\b)|(?:or else\b)|(?:you (?:are|you're) (?:selfish|disloyal|ungrateful|a coward)\b)|(?:if you really cared\b)|(?:anyone who (?:disagrees|refuses|says no)\b[^.!?]{0,50}\b(?:must leave|will be|is not welcome|cannot stay)))

patterns.title: Respect for disagreement followed by punishment
patterns.summary: An invitation to disagree is immediately reversed by a rule or consequence punishing disagreement.

\b(?:please (?:challenge|correct) me|i(?:'d| would) like to understand why you disagree)\b

patterns.title: Empathy followed by guilt or conditional approval
patterns.summary: Acknowledging someone's feelings is immediately followed by guilt or a demand presented as a test of loyalty or care.

\b(?:that (?:sounds|must have been) (?:upsetting|painful|difficult)|i want to understand what it was like for you)\b

patterns.title: Independent thinking followed by enforced agreement
patterns.summary: An invitation to make up your own mind is followed by a demand that the reader accept the speaker's view.
